description: This file contains utility methods for testing ZooKeeper connectivity, including ensuring ZooKeeper is running and available by attempting to connect and perform an existence check on a test node.

classes.name: ZookeeperTestUtils
classes.description: Provides static methods to check ZooKeeper service status for testing purposes.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A watcher implementation that handles ZooKeeper events, though it currently does nothing on event processing.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeper
methods.description: Public method to ensure ZooKeeper is running; throws exception if not.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that checks if ZooKeeper is accessible by establishing a connection and verifying the existence of a test node.
